name: tej-stack
description: Practical, evidence-first skills for solo founders building and shipping startups with AI coding agents.

interface.longDescription: Focused skills for auditing completed features, tracing failures, finding proven performance and cost wins, mapping code into clickable diagrams, and turning a real app into a promo video, all with evidence.
defaultPrompt: Audit this completed feature before I ship it.
Trace this failure from the real actor to its impact.
